title: Chapter 456: Tomb Of The King
content:
Chapter 456: Tomb Of The King

"Long time no see, Wang Shuo."

Wang Shuo was quite surprised when he saw the slightly stooped little old man.

"Lord Zach?"

Wang Shuo was surprised and confused. Master Zac hadn't contacted Wang Shuo for a long time. Wang Shuo felt that Master Zac had forgotten him.

"You've been doing very well during this time!"

Lord Zach looked at Wang Shuo with a kind smile on his face.

"Thank you, Lord Zach, for your compliments."

"I came here specifically to congratulate you on the founding of the country." Master Zach said, took out a token and handed it to Wang Shuo.

"This is a secret realm that can help people break through to the realm of the strongest king."

When Wang Shuo heard this, he was very excited.

In this way, there is hope for the rise of the Vana Empire.

After Lord Zach left, Wang Shuo's mood was still unable to calm down for a long time.

After the founding process was over, Wang Shuo immediately returned to his residence and took out the token.

[The Secret Realm of the Tomb of Kings: a secret realm with extremely high mortality rate. Only one person is allowed to enter at a time. 】

Wang Shuo felt a little uneasy when he saw this information.

Then, he called the national master Zhao Bonde over.

"Your Majesty, come to me in a hurry. What's the matter?"

Zhao Bangde heard the urgent move and ran over quickly.

"Old Zhao, look at this."

Wang Shuo handed the secret realm token to Zhao Bond.

After Zhao Bond looked at it, he also frowned.

Mainly because of the extremely high mortality rate, this statement frightened me.

"Your Majesty, what do you mean?"

"I plan to go there myself."

"This..., Your Majesty, why don't you let others try it first?"

Wang Shuo had already thought about it before Zhao Bond came.

If it cannot break through to the strongest king, the Vana Empire will be nothing more than a flash in the pan and may be annexed by other powerful empires at any time.

Might as well take the risk.

Not only Wang Shuo wants to enter, but also the high-level combat forces of the empire must enter to win a future.

If you unfortunately die in the Tomb of the King, it is your fate.

"People of our generation live to die, so we should move forward courageously."

Zhao Bangde fell silent when he saw that Wang Shuo had made up his mind.

"If I don't come back, I'll leave the empire to you."

Zhao Bond wanted to say something more, but he didn't say it out loud and just nodded.

Then, he squeezed out a few words from the corner of his mouth.

"Don't worry, I will protect this empire for you."

Wang Shuo did not tell anyone else about this secret realm, including Gong Zheng, Ayub and others.

The next day, Wang Shuo held his first court meeting.

In the splendid hall, after conducting a normal court meeting, Wang Shuo announced that he would be in seclusion for a period of time.

Now the empire is full of talents, with prime ministers and national advisors, and the empire itself can run smoothly.

In the afternoon, Wang Shuo bathed, changed clothes, burned incense and prayed, then entered the Tomb of the King.

With a flash of white light, Wang Shuo appeared under a gray sky.

The ground was full of broken tiles and ruins, a dilapidated scene.

A tombstone suddenly appeared on Wang Shuo's back.

A message appeared in my mind.

Wang Shuo frowned and understood the role of the tombstone.

If Wang Shuo died, the tombstone would bury Wang Shuo on the spot.

If Wang Shuo breaks through to the strongest king, he only needs to break the tombstone and leave here.

After a while, the tombstone could change in size according to Wang Shuo's wishes, and Wang Shuo put the tombstone away.

This is the key to leaving here, so don't lose it.

Wang Shuo looked far into the distance and found a tombstone standing not far away.
